description: Simulated three-class responses (lo, mid, hi) where the reference class lo never occurs for z1 > 0.7.
generator_code:
{
    n <- 600L
    d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(n), z1 = runif(n), z2 = factor(sample(c("a", "b", "c"), n, replace = TRUE)), 
        z3 = rnorm(n))
    lev <- c("lo", "mid", "hi")
    right <- d$z1 > 0.7
    em <- ifelse(right, 0.4 + 0.6 * d$x, 0.2 + 0.7 * d$x)
    eh <- ifelse(right, -0.3 - 0.8 * d$x, -0.1 - 0.5 * d$x)
    p <- cbind(ifelse(right, 0, 1), exp(em), exp(eh))
    p <- p/rowSums(p)
    u <- runif(n)
    d$y <- factor(lev[1L + (u > p[, 1L]) + (u > p[, 1L] + p[, 2L])], levels = lev)
    d
}
